fullContentHtml:
Indian Navy Agniveer MR Musician 02/2026 Batch Result - Complete Details

Short Information : Join Indian Navy has released the result for the post of Agniveer MR (Musician) 02/2026 Batch posts on the official website of the Indian Navy. Applications for the Indian Navy Agniveer MR Musician 02/2026 Batch Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 11 April 2026 to 30 April 2026. The written examination was held in May 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Indian Navy Agniveer MR Musician 02/2026 Batch Result 2026 which has given below.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
